title: Validate real receiver commitments and recovery
description:
Validate receiver commitments, half-duplex exclusion and failure recovery through the real scheduler/driver path. Include high-priority TX arriving during committed RX, overlapping operations, busy/error completion, timeout, cancellation and recovery. Consume full C integration and software compliance rather than reimplementing policy.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Require affirmative matching authority.10/rf.03 session approvals before ports, fault injection or RF. Scope fault methods in the approved protocol. Closed software gates or earlier RF clearance are not authorization for new operations; denied/mismatched scope leaves execution blocked or deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Independent event traces and correlated hardware observations verify permitted/denied operations and final states against rf.08 timing bounds. A single chain never receives on two channels simultaneously. Failures cannot bypass accounting or commitments; measured and software-only cases are labeled separately.
